# Doxygen Awesome CSS

Vendored, unmodified styles from [Doxygen Awesome v2.3.4](https://github.com/jothepro/doxygen-awesome-css/tree/v2.3.4), licensed under MIT (see LICENSE).

Included: `doxygen-awesome.css` and `doxygen-awesome-sidebar-only.css`.
The project-specific overrides live in `docs/doxygen/penguin-theme.css`.
All assets are local: generating or viewing the documentation requires no CDN or network access.
